turns.text: She sounds like a great assistant coach! What are your plans for tonight after you get back from the court?

turns.text: Grace and I are going to have a quiet evening. We're planning to start a new sci-fi series on that streaming service we got.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: A sci-fi series sounds like a fun way to wind down. I hope you find a great one to dive into! How have things been at the high school? Still keeping busy as head of the science department?

turns.text: Always busy, but it's going well. We are in a good groove right now, though I'm definitely enjoying having a break this weekend.
